thesis: Amazon DSP delivery drivers earn close to $24 per hour nationally, while heavy and tractor-trailer truck drivers had a $58,640 median annual wage in May 2025. The pay gap comes with different licensing, schedules, route types and time-away-from-home demands.

facts.claim: Amazon said its 2026 DSP investment is expected to raise national average Delivery Associate earnings to nearly $24 per hour.
Amazon announced another $1.9 billion for the DSP program in 2027 to support participating delivery companies and drivers.
BLS reports a May 2025 median wage of $58,640 per year, or $28.19 per hour, for heavy and tractor-trailer truck drivers.
BLS reports the lowest 10 percent below $40,140 and the highest 10 percent above $79,380 for heavy truck drivers in May 2025.
BLS reports a May 2025 national mean annual wage of $59,710 for heavy and tractor-trailer truck drivers.
FMCSA says most commercial truck drivers need a CDL and must meet knowledge, skills and applicable entry-level training requirements.
